checks: Guest theme persists successfully, or remains applied with exactly one storage warning
Rapid account preferences suppress obsolete responses; no false saved success; rejection stays an error
Custom add/select retains two existing writes with one toast; removal succeeds under StrictMode
Read helpers surface returned and thrown failures; failed count refresh preserves last counts and confirmed success
Public reset success preserves account privacy and does not replay after reload
Public recovery verification uses its confirmed session without a login welcome
A delayed public verification result cannot restore another account or show stale success
Dialog opening stays quiet; send/verify/update and deliberate later logout each notify once without unexpected-session feedback
Standalone Settings update/logout chain emits one combined outcome
Email verification and request/check-confirmation use confirmed status; pending is information; duplicate inline live announcements removed
Google startup failure uses safe copy and one announcement
Synthetic deletion reauthentication rejection cannot invoke deletion
Pending preference response is suppressed after account switch
A legitimate same-account preference completion still notifies after the form unmounts
Custom add/remove keeps in-memory state on unavailable storage, with one warning per action
Guest accent and font controls report their own local persistence outcomes
Bulk read uses the real action owner, sends one existing write, and confirms the returned row IDs
Double read activation is one write/outcome; unchanged read is quiet; later unread can notify again
Eligibility automatic check stays quiet; explicit checks notify; a lost code-send response is uncertain
Recovery logout rejection differs from post-logout navigation failure; password success is not contradicted
Email invalid-code rejection and uncertain send stay distinct and retain inline guidance
Email check distinguishes no completed change, and resend uses separate truthful copy
Synthetic deletion success survives intentional sign-out without a second unexpected-session toast
Registration account-created toast survives its intentional session transition and keeps the existing modal
Unsupported confirmation branch warns without claiming normal registration completion
Registration still reports confirmed account creation when local sign-out fails, without claiming logout
Actual Google callback handler redirects with one consumed error receipt; reload stays quiet and a later callback can notify again
Actual email callback handler delivers confirmed change, two-inbox pending and error once; destination reload does not replay
A callback receipt owned by another account is consumed without stale success
Empty, mismatched and incomplete returned write rows cannot produce a read-state success
Real Supabase/PostgREST write builder requests affected-row representation once per action and preserves ownership predicates; report read/unread successes use those rows
Shared host renders dark wide/narrow; dismissal causes no new request
Light/dark and open-dialog captures use the unchanged host; idle expiry triggers no work or repeated notification
limitations: Actual callback handlers, client components, Supabase/PostgREST writes, adapter and host with synthetic Auth/database/server-action outcomes. No live provider, real email, deletion or hosted integration was exercised.
Account appearance writes retain the permitted information fallback; real screen-reader and hosted integration checks remain manual.
